ibarnorigins.death.attack.ibarnorigins.soulBlast: %1$s was vaporized by concentrated soul energy
ibarnorigins.death.attack.ibarnorigins.soulBlast.play: %1$s was vaporized by concentrated soul energy whilst trying to escape %2$s
ibarnorigins.death.attack.ibarnorigins.soul_burn.play: %1$s's soul burned away whilst trying to escape %2$s
ibarnorigins.effect.ibarnorigins.casting_soul_firebal: Soul Sorcerers' soul fireball ability. Fires a soul fireball on effect resolution.
ibarnorigins.effect.ibarnorigins.fire_weakness_effect: Increases damage from fire sources by 100%.
ibarnorigins.effect.ibarnorigins.soul_fire_effect.des: Inflicts lethal armor and protection bypassing damage over time. If inflicted by a Soul Sorcerer, deals percentage-based damage based on the target's max health.
ibarnorigins.effect.ibarnorigins.soul_fire_strength_e: Increases melee damage by 50% at level 1 and 100% at level 2.
ibarnorigins.origin.ibarnorigins.ghaster.description: Far descendants of the Ghasts who were rescued from the Nether and who became more human due to their prolonged exposure to the Overworld.
ibarnorigins.origin.ibarnorigins.ghaster.name: Ghaster
ibarnorigins.origin.ibarnorigins.sandman.description: The Sand People are the people of the sand who live in the sand.
ibarnorigins.origin.ibarnorigins.sandman.name: Sand Person
ibarnorigins.origin.ibarnorigins.soul_wizard.descript: A sub-race of humans that are able to channel their soul energy.
ibarnorigins.origin.ibarnorigins.soul_wizard.name: Soul Sorcerer
ibarnorigins.origin.ibarnorigins.wither_phantom.descr: Half-living half-undead amalgamates who became permanently infused with withering powers as a result of fusions with wither cores.
ibarnorigins.origin.ibarnorigins.wither_phantom.name: Wither Wraith
ibarnorigins.power.ibarnorigins.ghasterexhaust.descri: Although you became more adapted to the Overworld, you are physically weak, mine stone slightly slower, deal 25% less melee damage, and can become exhausted quickly.
ibarnorigins.power.ibarnorigins.ghasterexhaust.name: Weak Physique
ibarnorigins.power.ibarnorigins.ghasterfireball.descr: Though you were left exposed to the Overworld, you have retained the vital fireballing ability of your ancestors, to a certain extent at least.
ibarnorigins.power.ibarnorigins.ghasterfireball.name: Fireball Instantiation
ibarnorigins.power.ibarnorigins.ghasterinflate.descri: Jumping while sneaking will cause you to inflate and float up for a short period of time.
ibarnorigins.power.ibarnorigins.ghasterinflate.name: Inflation
ibarnorigins.power.ibarnorigins.ki_immunity.descripti: You have a strong resistance to magic damage.
ibarnorigins.power.ibarnorigins.ki_immunity.name: Ki Resistance
ibarnorigins.power.ibarnorigins.kiblast.description: Charge up a special soul-burning fire ball that increases in power as your experience level rises (maxing out at level 100).
ibarnorigins.power.ibarnorigins.kiblast.name: Soul Fire Ball
ibarnorigins.power.ibarnorigins.sandman_attributes.de: Take less damage when standing on top of sand blocks but only deal 50% of damage when on anything other than sand. In addition, you will always spawn in a desert.
ibarnorigins.power.ibarnorigins.sandman_sandbury.desc: You are able to burrow yourself into the sand. While burrowed you are invisible.
ibarnorigins.power.ibarnorigins.sandman_sandbury.name: Sand Burrowing
ibarnorigins.power.ibarnorigins.soul_speed.descriptio: The soul energy in soul sand and soul soil allows you to travel faster.
ibarnorigins.power.ibarnorigins.soul_speed.name: Soul Speed
ibarnorigins.power.ibarnorigins.soulfire_strength.des: Deal an additional 50% amount of damage while standing near soul fire sources or holding their respective items. Moreover, standing directly inside soul fire will boost melee attacks to 100% additional damage and 50% additional soul fire ball damage.
ibarnorigins.power.ibarnorigins.soulmage_fireweakness: Although you feel fine near soul fire, the regular burning fire from torches and campfires has a strong weakening effect on you. As such, you also take an extra 100% more damage from fire and go blind upon taking fire damage.
ibarnorigins.power.ibarnorigins.soulmage_piglinfear.d: The primordial soul flame burning inside you instills fear into all but the most brave Piglins.
ibarnorigins.power.ibarnorigins.soulmage_vegetarian.d: Meat does not have as much soul energy as vegetables do. Hereby meat does not sustain for much but vegetables grant experience upon consumption based on how filling they are.
ibarnorigins.power.ibarnorigins.witherskull.descripti: Channel the forces of the undead and conjure wither skulls that seek out your foes.
ibarnorigins.power.ibarnorigins.witherskull.name: Homing Wither Skull
ibarnorigins.power.ibarnorigins.wp_item_prevention.de: You are unable to wear any armor higher than iron armor.
ibarnorigins.power.ibarnorigins.wpairswim.description: Your body is very light and you are capable of swimming through the air.
ibarnorigins.power.ibarnorigins.wpairswim.name: Flight
ibarnorigins.power.ibarnorigins.wphealth.description: Due to your fusion, your body became very frail (5 hearts) and you aren't able to dish out much raw melee damage.
ibarnorigins.power.ibarnorigins.wphealth.name: Frailty
ibarnorigins.power.ibarnorigins.wphit.description: With each hit you inflict the wither effect on your foes.
ibarnorigins.power.ibarnorigins.wphit.name: Withering Strikes

medievalorigins.badges.medievalorigins.high_elf.blazenbr: §cBlazenbreath:§r Press %s while holding coal in either hand to shoot forth a weak cone of flame. Hold blaze powder instead to shoot forth a moderate cone of flame. Scales with Fire Spell Power.
medievalorigins.badges.medievalorigins.high_elf.ebonbrea: §dEbonbreath:§r Press %s while holding bottled dragon's breath in either hand to shoot forth a cone of strong magical flame. Scales with Fire and Arcane Spell Power.
medievalorigins.badges.medievalorigins.high_elf.extrusiv: §4Extrusive Movement:§r Hold obsidian to channel the flow of heat and walk freely on smoldering lava
medievalorigins.badges.medievalorigins.high_elf.glacial_: §bGlacial Step:§r Hold an ice block to manipulate the entropy of water molecules, allowing you to walk as if you had Frost Walker
medievalorigins.badges.medievalorigins.high_elf.instant_: §eInstant Cure:§r Right click a villager with a golden apple to directly channel its healing energy without needing to weaken them
medievalorigins.badges.medievalorigins.high_elf.void_war: §5Void Warp:§r Press %s while holding an ender pearl to rip through the fabric of reality and teleport yourself directly where you're looking, up to 50 blocks away
medievalorigins.badges.medievalorigins.pixie.dash_forwar:
Dash - Press %s twice quickly to dash forward. 

This uses 50 §bFP§r if gliding, and 25 §bFP§r otherwise.
medievalorigins.badges.medievalorigins.pixie.dash_upward:
Dash Up - Quickly press %s then %s to dash upward. 

This also uses 50 §bFP§r if gliding, and 25 §bFP§r otherwise.
medievalorigins.badges.medievalorigins.pixie.disable_eff: Press %s while sneaking to disable sounds and particle effects
medievalorigins.badges.medievalorigins.pixie.glide:
Glide - Press %s in the air to glide gently using your wings. 

Uses no §bFP§r.
medievalorigins.badges.medievalorigins.pixie.hover:
Hover - Quickly press %s twice to begin hovering (a slower creative flight) and slowly drain §bFP§r. 

If your §bFP§r runs out completely, you'll stop hovering.
medievalorigins.badges.medievalorigins.pixie.jump:
Pixie jumps are 2 blocks high. They can also fly, which uses up §bFlight Power (FP)§r. 

 §bFP§r only regenerates while on the ground.
medievalorigins.badges.medievalorigins.revenant.command: Press %s to cycle between commanding your summons to sit, follow, or teleport to you.
medievalorigins.badges.medievalorigins.revenant.eat: Besides bones and rotten flesh, eating certain monster heads can charge this resource more quickly.
medievalorigins.badges.medievalorigins.revenant.siphon: Hit a living creature to drain its life force. Damage scales with accumulated resource and Soul Spell Power.
medievalorigins.badges.medievalorigins.revenant.summon_k: Summon with [%s] while holding the items listed in the other badges
medievalorigins.badges.medievalorigins.revenant.summon_s:
§f§nSkeleton Horse§r:
- Mainhand: 12 bones
- Offhand: 1 saddle
§oPermanent duration§r
medievalorigins.badges.medievalorigins.revenant.summon_w:
§7§nWither Skeleton§r:
- Mainhand: 12 bones
- Offhand: 1 wither skull
§oDuration: 30 minutes§r
medievalorigins.badges.medievalorigins.revenant.summon_z:
§2§nZombie Horse§r:
- Mainhand: 12 flesh
- Offhand: 1 saddle
§oPermanent duration§r
medievalorigins.badges.medievalorigins.revenant.summons_: You can only sustain up to 5 combat summons at a time.
medievalorigins.death.attack.blazenbreath.item: %1$s was burnt to a crisp by %2$s using %3$s
medievalorigins.death.attack.blazenbreath.player: %1$s was burnt to a crisp by %2$s
medievalorigins.death.attack.siphon.item: %1$s had their soul ripped apart by %2$s's %3$s
medievalorigins.death.attack.siphon.player: %1$s had their soul ripped apart by %2$s
medievalorigins.enchantment.medievalorigins.featherweigh: This enchantment can be applied to heavy armor to prevent slowing down Arachnae, Elves, Alfiq, or those with wings.
medievalorigins.enchantment.medievalorigins.mirroring.de: With this enchantment applied to helmets, players are immune to a Gorgon's petrifying gaze and Dwarves can see normally in the daylight.
medievalorigins.medievalorigins.black_thumb: The crops wilt at your touch!
medievalorigins.medievalorigins.contagious_villager: This villager will not trade with you!
medievalorigins.medievalorigins.disturbed_restless: What you know will kill you, but you will die laughing.
medievalorigins.medievalorigins.insomniac_welts: Your welts sting and burn. There will be no sleep for you tonight.
medievalorigins.medievalorigins.moon_elf_no_sleep: The strange sounds of this foreign world leave you restless.
medievalorigins.medievalorigins.poor_reputation_block: No villagers are willing to trade with you!
medievalorigins.medievalorigins.poor_reputation_villager: The villager is too scared to trade with you!
medievalorigins.medievalorigins.troublemaker: Villagers don't trade with the likes of you!
medievalorigins.medievalorigins.uncastable: You can't use this ability right now.
medievalorigins.message.medievalorigins.summon.come: §oHeel§r. Your summons are called to you.
medievalorigins.message.medievalorigins.summon.sit: §oHalt§r. Your summons are ordered to sit.
medievalorigins.origin.medievalorigins.alfiq.description:
§l§nOverview§r: 
§o§2+ Unarmed Bonus§r
§o§2+ Unique Movement§r
§o§6• Carnivore§r
§o§c- Defense§r
§lAlfiq§r are a cunning species of anthropomorphic felines with sharp claws and excellent agility. Their roads often lead to warm sands.
medievalorigins.origin.medievalorigins.alfiq.name: Alfiq
medievalorigins.origin.medievalorigins.arachnae.descript:
§l§nOverview§r: 
§o§2+ Poison, Crowd Control
+ Wall Climbing§r
§o§6• Carnivore§r
§o§c- Hunger, Armor§r
A grotesque amalgamation of spider and human, with venomous fangs and bristled feet yet the ability to walk upright and wield weaponry.
medievalorigins.origin.medievalorigins.arachnae.name: Arachnae
medievalorigins.origin.medievalorigins.banshee.descripti:
§l§nOverview§r: 
§o§2+ Flight, Support, Phasing§r
§o§6• Undead
§o§c- Defense§r
§o§c- Extreme changes, read first!§r
§lBanshees§r are anguished spirits whose cries can shatter glass and drive people to madness. In myth, their presence is often considered an omen of death.
medievalorigins.origin.medievalorigins.banshee.name: Banshee
medievalorigins.origin.medievalorigins.dwarf.description:
§l§nOverview§r: 
§o§2+ Mining, Caving§r
§o§6• Short: 102cm.3'7"§r
§o§c- Sun sensitive 
- Can't swim§r
§lDwarves§r are practical, stocky, and prideful. They excel at mining and living underground, but struggle with the daylight. Rock and stone, brother.
medievalorigins.origin.medievalorigins.dwarf.name: Dwarf
medievalorigins.origin.medievalorigins.fae.description:
§l§nOverview§r: 
§o§2+ Hovering, Magic§r
§o§6• Short: 122cm.4'0"§r
§o§c- Loved by Mobs§r
§lFae§r are magical woodland creatures of elegance, infused with natural magic and deeply connected to the forests from which they hail.
medievalorigins.origin.medievalorigins.fae.name: Fae
medievalorigins.origin.medievalorigins.goblin.descriptio:
§l§nOverview§r: 
§o§2+ Gold Gear Bonuses§r
§o§2+ Luck, Speed§r 
§o§6• Small: 92cm.3'3"§r 
§o§c- Health, Defense§r
§lGoblins§r are obsessed with gold and treasure and tend to find a little more loot wherever they look, but their small size leaves them vulnerable in combat.
medievalorigins.origin.medievalorigins.goblin.name: Goblin
medievalorigins.origin.medievalorigins.gorgon.descriptio:
§l§nOverview§r: 
§o§2+ Poison Damage, Immunity§r
§o§2+ Crowd Control§r
§o§c- Hydrophobe 
- Unique weaknesses§r
§lGorgons§r are cursed creatures who were once human, with hair made of writhing snakes and a haunting visage said to petrify those who witness it.
medievalorigins.origin.medievalorigins.gorgon.name: Gorgon
medievalorigins.origin.medievalorigins.high_elf.arcanist:
High Elves are innately more talented in one element, decided at birth. 

A mage consumed with mastering the esoteric and the unknown. 

+1 Arcane Spell Power
medievalorigins.origin.medievalorigins.high_elf.cryomanc:
A calm, wise soul who focuses on control and strategy. 

+1 Frost Spell Power
medievalorigins.origin.medievalorigins.high_elf.descript:
§l§nOverview§r: 
§o§2+ Magic, Unique Abilities§r
§o§c- Physical Damage
- Defense§r
§lHigh Elves§r are notoriously arrogant, though undeniably talented; elemental magics course strongly through their blood, though they are weaker with weaponry.
medievalorigins.origin.medievalorigins.high_elf.name: High Elf
medievalorigins.origin.medievalorigins.high_elf.pyromanc:
A lunatic who derives pleasure from watching things burn. 

+1 Fire Spell Power
medievalorigins.origin.medievalorigins.incubus.descripti:
§l§nOverview§r: 
§o§2+ Nether Bonuses
§o§6• Fire-based
§o§c- Damaged by Water§r
§o§c- Weak in Overworld§r
§lIncubi§r are evil servants of a dark power. They are powerful in their own realm, but in exchange for this they have given up their soul, and are weak to pure sources.
medievalorigins.origin.medievalorigins.incubus.name: Incubus
medievalorigins.origin.medievalorigins.moon_elf.descript:
§l§nOverview§r: 
§o§2+ Dagger Damage
+ Dextrous§r
§o§6• Stealthy, Doesn't Sleep§r
§o§c- Defense§r
Mysterious, ethereal beings not of this world. Moon elves are named not for their homeland, but for the only thing their victims can see before their end.
medievalorigins.origin.medievalorigins.moon_elf.name: Moon Elf
medievalorigins.origin.medievalorigins.ogre.description:
§l§nOverview§r: 
§o§2+ Axe Bonuses, Defense §r
§o§6• Massive: 268cm.9'5"§r
§o§c- Hunger, Speed §r
§lOgres§r are a large, short-tempered, and brutish subspecies of Orc. Their lumbering size and limited intelligence are made up for by their raw strength.
medievalorigins.origin.medievalorigins.ogre.name: Ogre
medievalorigins.origin.medievalorigins.pixie.description:
§l§nOverview§r: 
§o§2+ Unique Flight, Odd§r
§o§6• Tiny: 22cm.9" §r
§o§c- Defense, Reputation §r
Often considered harbingers of good fortune, but also tricky, untrustworthy agents of mischief. Pixies are whimsical and very, very small.
medievalorigins.origin.medievalorigins.pixie.name: Pixie
medievalorigins.origin.medievalorigins.plague_victim.des:
§l§nOverview§r: 
§o§2+ Withering §r
§o§6• Unique playstyle §r
§o§6• Undead §r
§o§c- Defense, Reputation 
§o§c- Difficult§r
Disease-ridden half-dead creatures who can no longer be called human, cursed and trapped in eternal suffering as a result of a strange magical illness.
medievalorigins.origin.medievalorigins.revenant.descript:
§l§nOverview§r: 
§o§2+ Summons §r
§o§2+ Illager Friendly 
§o§6• Undead, Complex §r
§o§c- Reputation
- Living interactions §r
§lRevenants§r are misfortunate souls who died gruesome and painful deaths, but inexplicably returned to life. As a result, they become obsessed with manipulating life and death in other creatures.
medievalorigins.origin.medievalorigins.revenant.name: Revenant
medievalorigins.origin.medievalorigins.siren.description:
§l§nOverview§r: 
§o§2+ Water-Based, Utility §r
§o§6• Weaker on Land§r
§o§c- Vulnerable to Fire§r
§lSirens§r are said to be a type of Merfolk. They have an ensnaring aura and their irresistible beauty is said to be the downfall of many a foolish sailor.
medievalorigins.origin.medievalorigins.siren.name: Siren
medievalorigins.origin.medievalorigins.valkyrie.descript:
§l§nOverview§r: 
§o§2+ Healing§r 
§o§6• Feathered wings§r 
§o§c- Weak to Undead§r
§lValkyrie§r are fearless winged warriors who decide the fate of those in battle; they were said to have carried the dead to Odin's Valhalla
medievalorigins.origin.medievalorigins.valkyrie.name: Valkyrie
medievalorigins.origin.medievalorigins.wood_elf.descript:
§l§nOverview§r: 
§o§2+ Ranged Bonuses, Speed§r
§o§6• Stealthy, Vegetarian§r
§o§c- Defense§r
§lWood Elves§r are a wise, long-lived race who live in harmony with the Earth. They are quick with a sword and bow and can outwit their enemies while among the trees.
medievalorigins.origin.medievalorigins.wood_elf.name: Wood Elf
medievalorigins.origin.medievalorigins.yeti.description:
§l§nOverview§r: 
§o§2+ Frost-Based, Tanky§r
§o§6• Large: 203cm.6'8"§r
§o§c- Heat Sensitive§r
Thick-furred beasts from frosty woods, a Yeti's dominion over ice allows them to freeze foes, but they are especially vulnerable to fiery attacks.
medievalorigins.origin.medievalorigins.yeti.name: Yeti
medievalorigins.origin.origins.human.description:
§l§nOverview§r: 
A human's fate is more open than most - venture forth with no benefits or drawbacks.
medievalorigins.power.medievalorigins.alfiq.agile_prefer: Alfiq prefer to wear only light armors for ease of movement. Heavier armors can be worn without penalty with an enchantment.
medievalorigins.power.medievalorigins.alfiq.clawed.descr: Alfiq have razor sharp retractable claws; they deal extra damage with empty paws, and can climb up and cling to steep surfaces (Can be toggled)
medievalorigins.power.medievalorigins.alfiq.clawed.name: Clawed
Near sunset and sunrise, Alfiq will move and attack much more quickly. At other times, they are lethargic and slightly slower.
medievalorigins.power.medievalorigins.alfiq.meow.name: Meow
medievalorigins.power.medievalorigins.alfiq.on_your_feet: If, while landing, you are looking straight down, take no damage from the fall.
medievalorigins.power.medievalorigins.alfiq.pickpocket.d: Right click the back of a villager while crouching with empty paws for a chance to steal some emeralds. Or get caught. Rumor has it you may be able to steal from other players.
medievalorigins.power.medievalorigins.alfiq.poor_grip.de: Alfiq have reduced breaking speed with tools and reduced damage with handled weapons like swords and axes.
medievalorigins.power.medievalorigins.alfiq.pounce.descr: After briefly crouching without moving to charge up, an Alfiq can leap forward a great distance. Striking an enemy during the pounce deals bonus damage.
medievalorigins.power.medievalorigins.alfiq.pounce.name: Pounce
medievalorigins.power.medievalorigins.arachnae.bottomles: Arachnae require a larger quantity of food to stay alive.
medievalorigins.power.medievalorigins.arachnae.brittle.d: The Arachnae's chitinous exoskeleton makes it difficult to move if wearing armor heavier than iron. This can be prevented with an enchantment.
medievalorigins.power.medievalorigins.arachnae.climber.d: The fine bristles on the Arachnae's legs allow them to climb up walls.
medievalorigins.power.medievalorigins.arachnae.fragile_e: The Arachnae's exoskeleton is more vulnerable to damage. They have slightly less health than a regular human.
medievalorigins.power.medievalorigins.arachnae.many_eyes: The Arachnae's eight eyes are all adpated to darkness, and allow them to see clearly even with very little light.
medievalorigins.power.medievalorigins.arachnae.venomous_: Arachnae's fangs contain venom, and every attack has a chance to inflict poison.
medievalorigins.power.medievalorigins.banshee.cursed_sig: You deal increased damage when wielding a cursed weapon.
medievalorigins.power.medievalorigins.banshee.cursed_war: You resist additional damage for each piece of cursed armor worn.
medievalorigins.power.medievalorigins.banshee.dimeritium: Magically suppressive metals, such as iron or silver, are completely intolerable to banshees.
medievalorigins.power.medievalorigins.banshee.hexed.desc: Banshees are shrouded in curses. Every time they are hit, there is a small chance that the attacker will be consigned to a fate of slow, agonising death.
medievalorigins.power.medievalorigins.banshee.hexed.name: Hexed
medievalorigins.power.medievalorigins.banshee.immaterial: Banshees have half the health a living person would have.
medievalorigins.power.medievalorigins.banshee.lunar_nexu: Banshees restore no hunger from food - their energy is only restored by direct moonlight, however, they cannot starve.
medievalorigins.power.medievalorigins.banshee.sonic_shri: Banshee's shrieks forewarn death. They can unleash an earsplitting wail, pushing back nearby entities and summoning a small protective circle. Targets hit directly by the shriek will be disoriented
medievalorigins.power.medievalorigins.banshee.spectral.d: Banshees possess the ability to become intangible, moving freely throughout the physical realm while being unable to interact with it. This uses tremendous energy and can not be activated while low on hunger.
medievalorigins.power.medievalorigins.dwarf.darkness_dwe: Direct sunlight will burn dwarven eyes, blinding them temporarily. Preventable with an enchantment or a gold helmet.
medievalorigins.power.medievalorigins.dwarf.dense.descri: Dwarves are extremely heavy for their size; they sink rapidly in water.
medievalorigins.power.medievalorigins.dwarf.dense.name: Dense
medievalorigins.power.medievalorigins.dwarf.dwarven_tech: Dwarves are capable of mining stone without a pickaxe, and mine anything faster than others.
medievalorigins.power.medievalorigins.dwarf.miniature.de: Dwarves are just short enough to fit into a 1 meter tall tunnel (and almost as wide as one).
medievalorigins.power.medievalorigins.dwarf.nocturnal_ey: Dwarves can focus to see clearly without needing any light source.
Dwarves are notorious for their powerful drinks which would knock out someone twice their size. Activate to take a swig and fully restore health.
medievalorigins.power.medievalorigins.fae.allure.descrip: Fae are naturally alluring. Mobs will pursue them from much further away than they would other creatures.
medievalorigins.power.medievalorigins.fae.allure.name: Allure
medievalorigins.power.medievalorigins.fae.diminutive.des: Fae are fairly short, most barely being taller than the average goblin.
medievalorigins.power.medievalorigins.fae.forest_kin.des: While you are within the embrace of a forest, your wounds mend faster.
Iron and silver inhibit fae powers. It is unbearable for them to wear it.
medievalorigins.power.medievalorigins.fae.levitation.des: Fae are light, winged creatures who can float effortlessly on the air.
medievalorigins.power.medievalorigins.fae.natures_blessi: Channel potent life energies for a short duration. While active, spread seeds onto stepped-on farmland and pulse healing and cleansing energy to nearby allies.
medievalorigins.power.medievalorigins.fae.natures_ward.d: You are bound to nature, granting you immunity to poison and nausea, and resistance against magical attacks.
medievalorigins.power.medievalorigins.fae.nourishment.de: Spread a burst of vital life energy, instantly fertilizing plants in an area around you.
medievalorigins.power.medievalorigins.fae.reduced_health: Fae are delicate creatures with less health than a human.
medievalorigins.power.medievalorigins.goblin.cunning.des: Goblins are clever creatures, and know where to find more rare loot most others would miss.
Gold in a goblin's hands lasts for much longer than most others who are careless with it.
medievalorigins.power.medievalorigins.goblin.frail.descr: Due to their small stature, goblins' have less health and are more prone to damage.
medievalorigins.power.medievalorigins.goblin.frail.name: Frail
medievalorigins.power.medievalorigins.goblin.greedy.desc: Goblins have a special relationship with treasure - they gain extra bonuses when using or wearing golden gear.
medievalorigins.power.medievalorigins.goblin.greedy.name: Greedy
medievalorigins.power.medievalorigins.goblin.nippy.descr: Although short, goblins are quite fast, allowing them to outrun most stronger enemies instead of fighting.
medievalorigins.power.medievalorigins.goblin.nippy.name: Nimble
medievalorigins.power.medievalorigins.goblin.stunted.des: Goblins are very short, at less than half the height of a human.
Gorgons can not tolerate the purity of water and take damage from it.
medievalorigins.power.medievalorigins.gorgon.petrifying_: Meet the eyes of any mob facing you, turning them to stone briefly. Does not work on bosses.
medievalorigins.power.medievalorigins.gorgon.poison_bloo: Gorgons are immune to poison, and have a chance to spill their toxic blood onto nearby enemies when hit, poisoning them.
medievalorigins.power.medievalorigins.gorgon.revenge.des: Gorgons deal signifcantly increased damage at low health.
medievalorigins.power.medievalorigins.gorgon.silver_aver: Gorgons are weak to the purity of silver - they can not stand to wear it and take damage when wielding it. (Iron is also counted as silver)
medievalorigins.power.medievalorigins.gorgon.to_stone.de: Gorgons were doomed to stay bound in dark caves and old dungeons. Being outside in daylight causes them to become petrified until night. Can be negated by wearing a helmet.
medievalorigins.power.medievalorigins.high_elf.ebonbreat: By holding different items, high elves can channel the object's energy to unleash various magics. Hover over each box to see details.
medievalorigins.power.medievalorigins.high_elf.elegant.d: High Elves are slowed by wearing heavy armor (This can be prevented with an enchantment), and have less health.
medievalorigins.power.medievalorigins.high_elf.fragile.d: A High Elf is not built for hand to hand combat. They are much more susceptible to physical damage, and have less health.
High Elves naturally have more mana than other races, and can channel the power of their elders to regenerate mana quickly.
medievalorigins.power.medievalorigins.high_elf.mana_iron: High Elves naturally have more mana than other races, and can channel the power of their elders to regenerate mana quickly.
High Elves naturally have more mana than other races, and can channel the power of their elders to regenerate mana quickly.
medievalorigins.power.medievalorigins.high_elf.mana_rpgm: High Elves naturally have more mana than other races, and can channel the power of their elders to regenerate mana quickly.
medievalorigins.power.medievalorigins.high_elf.mystic_af: High Elves are powerful and clever manipulators of arcane energy - they deal more magic damage and take less magic damage than other races.
High Elves are slender and slightly taller than the average human.
Humans have no changes from the base game.
An incubus' bloodlust is insatiable. If it isn't the flesh of an animal, its worthless.
medievalorigins.power.medievalorigins.incubus.demon_fire: Incubi are innately more potent with all fire magics, and can release a burst of flame at will. Scales with Fire Spell Power.
medievalorigins.power.medievalorigins.incubus.dimension_: Incubi are not accustomed to dimensions where the sun shines and are weaker there, but they are considerably stronger in the Nether.
Fire feels like home - it deals no damage to Incubi and satiates them.
medievalorigins.power.medievalorigins.incubus.hydrophobe: Water scalds Incubi, damaging them on contact.
medievalorigins.power.medievalorigins.incubus.impure.des: Incubi take extra damage from Smite and reverted effects from healing and harming.
medievalorigins.power.medievalorigins.incubus.unholy_dea: An incubus can exchange some of their life force for raw power for a short time. Triggered with Primary Active key.
medievalorigins.power.medievalorigins.moon_elf.crazed.de: Try as they might, Moon Elves can not sleep in the overworld.
medievalorigins.power.medievalorigins.moon_elf.elegant.d: Moon Elves are slowed by wearing heavy armor. This can be prevented with an enchantment.
Moon elves are thin and even slightly translucent, and their skin has a peculiar blue hue.
medievalorigins.power.medievalorigins.moon_elf.fragile.d: Moon Elves have reduced health and take increased physical damage.
medievalorigins.power.medievalorigins.moon_elf.moonlight: Moon Elves are most efficient wielding a light and easy to conceal weapon. They deal more damage with daggers and knives.
medievalorigins.power.medievalorigins.moon_elf.nimble.de: With their quick reflexes, Moon Elves have a small chance to dodge any attack.
medievalorigins.power.medievalorigins.moon_elf.stealth.d: In the dark, Moon Elves can turn invisible by sneaking, and move a short distance while stealthed. When attacking from stealth, their first attack deals bonus damage and ends the invisibility. This deals extra damage if wielding a dagger.
Moon Elves are about the same height as their distant relatives of the forest, making them slightly taller than humans.
medievalorigins.power.medievalorigins.ogre.bloodlust.des: Ogres are known to unpredictably fly into a blinding rage, where they can stomp through a horde of foes quickly but can barely make out what's happening around them.
medievalorigins.power.medievalorigins.ogre.gargantuan.de: Ogres are massive, and can't fit through doors or even in many small structures.
medievalorigins.power.medievalorigins.ogre.lead_belly.de: Ogres care little for what they eat. Food is food. They do not experience poison or hunger.
medievalorigins.power.medievalorigins.ogre.ravager.descr: Axes feel right in an Ogre's hand; this comfort allows them to swing with much more force.
medievalorigins.power.medievalorigins.ogre.ravager.name: Ravager
medievalorigins.power.medievalorigins.ogre.ravenous.desc: Ogres are almost never full; they need to eat near constantly to stay satisfied.'
medievalorigins.power.medievalorigins.ogre.ravenous.name: Ravenous
medievalorigins.power.medievalorigins.ogre.sluggish.desc: Ogres are slower than most, to conserve some of their energy despite their massive size.
medievalorigins.power.medievalorigins.ogre.sluggish.name: Sluggish
medievalorigins.power.medievalorigins.ogre.stocky.descri: Ogres' thick skin and dense bones make them able to tank many more hits than others.
medievalorigins.power.medievalorigins.ogre.stocky.name: Stocky
medievalorigins.power.medievalorigins.pixie.curse_of_fli: Pixies cannot wear chestplates more substantial than leather, and can not use other wings to fly differently.
medievalorigins.power.medievalorigins.pixie.feather_foot: Pixies are so light, it is impossible for them to take fall damage.
medievalorigins.power.medievalorigins.pixie.flight.descr:
Pixies can fly and propel themselves forward and upward.
Read the boxes next to this power for instructions on how to fly.
medievalorigins.power.medievalorigins.pixie.flight.name: On the Dusts
medievalorigins.power.medievalorigins.pixie.good_fortune: Although pixies can be troublesome, they are also associated with good luck. When mining, they will occasionally get something valubale from plain stone.
medievalorigins.power.medievalorigins.pixie.mount.descri: You can sit on top of another player's head by right clicking them with empty hands.
medievalorigins.power.medievalorigins.pixie.mount.name: Shortcut
medievalorigins.power.medievalorigins.pixie.pixie_proper: Pixies are some of the smallest creatures to roam the land, rarely even reaching the average human's knee.
medievalorigins.power.medievalorigins.pixie.soaked.descr: Being as small as they are, water poses signficant threat to pixies. It hampers their movement and impairs their ability to fly.
medievalorigins.power.medievalorigins.pixie.soaked.name: Soaked
medievalorigins.power.medievalorigins.pixie.troublemaker: Villagers know pixies by the legends of trouble they cause, and will refuse to trade with them.
medievalorigins.power.medievalorigins.plague_victim.cont: The Plagued are a horrifying sight. Villagers will refuse to trade with them out of fear.
medievalorigins.power.medievalorigins.plague_victim.eter: Once every 5 minutes, upon death, the Plagued are instead forcefully kept alive to prolong their torment.
medievalorigins.power.medievalorigins.plague_victim.foul: A horrifying magic swarms the victim, and slowly consumes the life of any living nearby.
medievalorigins.power.medievalorigins.plague_victim.inso: Sleep is impossible for the Plagued, due to their unending agony.
medievalorigins.power.medievalorigins.plague_victim.plag: Though the immense pain never ends, there is only so much tissue that can die. Carriers are immune to poison and wither.
medievalorigins.power.medievalorigins.plague_victim.risk: Every time you strike, there is a chance to spread the infection.
medievalorigins.power.medievalorigins.plague_victim.sens: The Plagued are covered in welts and lesions upon the skin, tender and painful to touch. Its victims cannot wear armor for the pain it causes.
medievalorigins.power.medievalorigins.plague_victim.skin: This illness drains the spirit, resulting in reduced health and speed.
medievalorigins.power.medievalorigins.revenant.black_thu: A Revenant can not harvest any crops; they wilt at their deathly touch.
medievalorigins.power.medievalorigins.revenant.command_s: Command your summoned combat undead (not horses) to follow, sit, or teleport to you.
medievalorigins.power.medievalorigins.revenant.disturbed: Experimenting in the forbidden warps the mind. Revenants cannot sleep, too scared to dream of what they wish they did not know.
medievalorigins.power.medievalorigins.revenant.hellraise: At will, a revenant can raise a circle of inert skeletons, acting as a temporary shield to protect them from danger and damage nearby enemies.
medievalorigins.power.medievalorigins.revenant.poor_repu: Villagers will refuse to trade with revenants and iron golems will attack them on sight. However, they are tolerated (tenuously) by Pillagers.
medievalorigins.power.medievalorigins.revenant.putrid_co:
Through the unsettling act of consuming the flesh or bones of the undead, a revenant can empower their next summon of the same type. 
For combat creatures, extend their duration, making them permanent at max power. For undead steeds, enhance their attributes at max power.
medievalorigins.power.medievalorigins.revenant.siphon.de: When hit, revenants slowly build up a power which allows them to siphon life from their enemies. This affects all creatures for better or worse, except summoned dead.
medievalorigins.power.medievalorigins.revenant.skeleton_: Revenants can reconstruct creatures of the night modified to do their own bidding. These act as pets, will follow and teleport, and can be equipped with weapons or armor. Zombies can not use bows. Hover the badges for details.
medievalorigins.power.medievalorigins.revenant.unguarded: Obsessing over the spirit realm leaves revenants more open to attack in the physical realm. Most mobs deal more damage to them.
medievalorigins.power.medievalorigins.revenant.unwithera: Revenants are immune to wither, and, like undead, they take extra damage from smite, receive inverted effects from harming and healing effects, and are immune to poison and regeneration effects.
medievalorigins.power.medievalorigins.siren.amphibious.d: In water, sirens can breathe and interact normally, see perfectly clearly, and they swim with increased speed.
medievalorigins.power.medievalorigins.siren.flammable.de: Sirens and fire do not mix. Any contact with flame will result in near-instant death.
medievalorigins.power.medievalorigins.siren.holy_water.d: Sirens have much more quickly regenerating bodies, but only while fully submerged.
medievalorigins.power.medievalorigins.siren.out_of_your_: While on land, Sirens can only heal or regenerate by using potions.
medievalorigins.power.medievalorigins.siren.seduce.descr: Press the secondary active key to gain favor with a villager and receive better trades from them.
medievalorigins.power.medievalorigins.siren.seduce.name: Captivating
medievalorigins.power.medievalorigins.siren.siren_song.d: Activate to overwhelm enemies in a large area, preventing them from harming you for a short time. Does not work on bosses or players.
medievalorigins.power.medievalorigins.valkyrie.corruptio: Nearby undead mobs weaken and slow you, and their attacks deal more damage to you.
medievalorigins.power.medievalorigins.valkyrie.divine_sm: Every third attack, smite nearby foes. Damage scales with healing spell power.
medievalorigins.power.medievalorigins.valkyrie.heavenly_: Valkyrie have innately more healing spell power and are more potent with lance or spear-like weapons.
medievalorigins.power.medievalorigins.valkyrie.intervent:
Leap upward into the air or dash forward if already flying, gaining fall immunity until you land. 

Upon landing or after 10 seconds, strike the area with holy energy, cleansing negative effects from nearby allies and healing them, and pushing back non-allies. Heal scales with healing spell power.
medievalorigins.power.medievalorigins.valkyrie.vanquishe: Upon slaying an undead mob, trigger §nDivine Smite§r§r§r and slightly reduce the effects of §nCorruption§r for each slain. Lose half stacks on death.
medievalorigins.power.medievalorigins.valkyrie.wings.des: Valkyrie have massive white feathered wings, and can fly freely.
medievalorigins.power.medievalorigins.wood_elf.archer.de: Wood Elves spend their whole lives training with bows - their arrows are always more deadly.
medievalorigins.power.medievalorigins.wood_elf.eagle_eye: Wood Elves can track an enemy for a short time after damaging them, even when they aren't in view.
medievalorigins.power.medievalorigins.wood_elf.elegant.d: Wood Elves have less health and are slowed by wearing heavy armor (This can be prevented with an enchantment).
medievalorigins.power.medievalorigins.wood_elf.empowered: After charging a bow for a few seconds, release an arrow with increased velocity and precision to fly further and truer, and pierce through 2 enemies.
medievalorigins.power.medievalorigins.wood_elf.forest_vi: While in tall shrubbery or leaves, wood elves can crouch to gain night vision and become undetectable to nearby mobs.
Wood elves are not as powerful, but they are quick. Your attacks deal reduced damage but are slightly faster.
medievalorigins.power.medievalorigins.wood_elf.steward.d: Wood elves live off of and in harmony the forest - They can not digest meat.
Wood elves are slightly taller than the average human.
medievalorigins.power.medievalorigins.yeti.flammable.des: Yetis are susceptible to fire damage due to their wintry nature.
Yeti can entomb nearby foes in ice on command. Does not work in the nether or on bosses.
medievalorigins.power.medievalorigins.yeti.from_whence_y: In icy biomes, yetis move faster and negate fall damage.
medievalorigins.power.medievalorigins.yeti.frosty_breath: The frosty breath of the yeti slows any opponents that get close to them.
medievalorigins.power.medievalorigins.yeti.thick_fur.des: In deserts, thick fur becomes a curse - it slows Yetis' movement and reduces health
medievalorigins.power.medievalorigins.yeti.titanic.descr: Yetis have far more health than a regular human.
medievalorigins.power.medievalorigins.yeti.titanic.name: Titanic
medievalorigins.power.medievalorigins.yeti.unstoppable.d: Yetis are immune to the slowness effect.
medievalorigins.power.medievalorigins.yeti.winter_body.d: Yetis are marginally taller than a regular human, and significantly wider.

origins_backgrounds.power.origins_backgrounds.legacy_sword.d: You carry your family's sword. It was your father's, and his mother's and...
origins_backgrounds.power.origins_backgrounds.paperbacks.des: After transcribing so many books, you only need three paper to bind one.
origins_backgrounds.power.origins_backgrounds.potion_food.de: You've ingested so many potions they are now nutritious and Healing.

pathfinder_origins.\"The Lady of Graves\", \"Mother of Soul: "The Lady of Graves", "Mother of Souls", "Gray Lady", Pharasma is the goddess of birth, death, and prophecy. She shepherds Golarion's recently departed souls to their final reward. Upon death, souls migrate via the River of Souls to Pharasma's Boneyard in the Outer Sphere, which sits atop an impossibly tall spire that pierces the Astral Plane. She is among the most ancient deities in the multiverse, but keeps her knowledge of the fate of all souls closely guarded.
pathfinder_origins.A cloud of golden particles covers every: A cloud of golden particles covers everyone and everything in the area, visibly outlining invisible things for the duration of the spell.
pathfinder_origins.Aasimars are humans with a significant a:
Aasimars are humans with a significant amount of celestial or other good outsider blood in their ancestry. While not always benevolent, aasimars are more inclined toward acts of kindness rather than evil. Aasimar heritage can lie dormant for generations, only to appear suddenly in the child of two apparently human parents.

Most societies interpret aasimar births as good omens, though it must be acknowledged that some aasimars take advantage of the reputation of their kind, brutally subverting the expectations of others with acts of terrifying cruelty or abject venality.
pathfinder_origins.Aasimars possess the ability to manifest: Aasimars possess the ability to manifest halos. They can create a light centered on their head.
pathfinder_origins.Abadar, the god of cities, law, merchant: Abadar, the god of cities, law, merchants, and wealth, also called 'The God of Walls and Ditches' in the eastern Dragon Empires, is known to be a patient deity. Maintaining a strong neutral stance in his actions, he sets forth to expand civilization and order among the peoples of Golarion.
pathfinder_origins.Alchemists start with a brewing stand: Alchemists start with a brewing stand
pathfinder_origins.Also called a ru-shi, a jiang-shi-born i: Also called a ru-shi, a jiang-shi-born is usually the result of some foul ritual or a magically possessed father rather than direct congress between a human and jiang-shi. Jiang-shis lack any natural desire for physical contact or procreation, and their putrefying internal organs make most unable to conceive.
pathfinder_origins.Also known as the Mantis God, Achaekek d: Also known as the Mantis God, Achaekek does not actively seek worshipers, but it has them nonetheless — He Who Walks in Blood is the divine patron of the assassins known as the Red Mantis, a group of infamous murderers who use the methods and themes of the Mantis God to strengthen their own notoriety.
pathfinder_origins.Although many tieflings follow the gener: Although many tieflings follow the general model of the tiefling, many more do not. Those of different lineages may evince dramatically different manifestations of their heritage, both in appearance and in ability.
pathfinder_origins.An innate sense of jealousy and pure mal: An innate sense of jealousy and pure malice drives spitespawn to spread misery and despair. Unable to experience joy themselves, they devote their lives to promoting gloom, all the while hiding the hatefulness that lurks at their core.
pathfinder_origins.Angelkin are mortal paragons of exceptio: Angelkin are mortal paragons of exceptional beauty, and they serve as exemplars of good and light regardless of the myriad forms they may take.
pathfinder_origins.Apsu is the patron deity of all good and: Apsu is the patron deity of all good and metallic dragons, and one of the oldest gods of the Great Beyond. According to the draconic creation myth, he was one of the primordial dragons who created the solar system and its inhabitants from the chaos of the Universe. He is battling endlessly with his son, the evil god Dahak the Sorrowmaker. Apsu has no oracles, for he believes inflicting a curse on a living creature is a terrible crime against that being, even in exchange for divine power.
pathfinder_origins.Asmodeus, also known as \"King of Hell\": Asmodeus, also known as "King of Hell", "Master of Witches" and "Prince of Law", is the most powerful of the nine archdevils that inhabit Hell, and the only one of Hell's rulers to claim full divinity. It was he who is credited with the penning the contract of creation, within which his followers believe is hidden the means for their patron's eventual rise to supremacy. Apsu has no oracles, for he believes inflicting a curse on a living creature is a terrible crime against that being, even in exchange for divine power.
pathfinder_origins.Barbarians excel in combat, possessing t: Barbarians excel in combat, possessing the martial prowess and fortitude to take on foes seemingly far superior to themselves. With rage granting them boldness and daring beyond that of most other warriors, barbarians charge furiously into battle and ruin all who would stand in their way.
pathfinder_origins.Bards capably confuse and confound their: Bards capably confuse and confound their foes while inspiring their allies to ever-greater daring. While accomplished with both weapons and magic, the true strength of bards lies outside melee, where they can support their companions and undermine their foes without fear of interruptions to their performances.
pathfinder_origins.Beastbrood regard themselves as deservin: Beastbrood regard themselves as deserving of appreciation and opulence. Through deceit and sheer willpower, they often achieve privileged stations in society.
pathfinder_origins.Beyond the veil of the mundane hide the: Beyond the veil of the mundane hide the secrets of absolute power. The works of beings beyond mortals, the legends of realms where gods and spirits tread, the lore of creations both wondrous and terrible such mysteries call to those with the ambition and the intellect to rise above the common folk to grasp true might. Such is the path of the wizard. These shrewd magic-users seek, collect, and covet esoteric knowledge, drawing on cultic arts to work wonders beyond the abilities of mere mortals. While some might choose a particular field of magical study and become masters of such powers, others embrace versatility, reveling in the unbounded wonders of all magic. In either case, wizards prove a cunning and potent lot, capable of smiting their foes, empowering their allies, and shaping the world to their every desire.
pathfinder_origins.Bloodragers possess an innate ability to: Bloodragers possess an innate ability to engage arcane powers from their bloodlines through sheer rage. Their anger can draw them into a state of bloodrage that manifests their fury in supernatural ways determined by their ancestral heritage.
pathfinder_origins.Calistria, also known as \"The Savored S: Calistria, also known as "The Savored Sting" and "The Unquenchable Fire," is the goddess of lust and revenge who takes on many faces and guises. She is held in especially high regard by elves, who often identify with her mercurial moods and changeable nature. A fondness for wasps has earned this vengeful deity the title of "the Savored Sting"; such creatures live on after harming their enemies, a trait Calistria's followers hope to emulate when pursuing their goals.
pathfinder_origins.Capable of calling upon the power of the: Capable of calling upon the power of the gods in the form of blessings and spells, warpriests blend divine magic with martial skill. They are unflinching bastions of their faith, shouting gospel as they pummel foes into submission, and never shy away from a challenge to their beliefs. While clerics might be subtle and use diplomacy to accomplish their aims, warpriests aren't above using violence whenever the situation warrants it. In many faiths, warpriests form the core of the church's martial forces —reclaiming lost relics, rescuing captured clergy, and defending the church's tenets from all challenges.
pathfinder_origins.Cayden Cailean, the god of alcohol, brav: Cayden Cailean, the god of alcohol, bravery, and freedom, is one of the Ascended: those mortals who achieved godhood by passing the Test of the Starstone. Because legend tells that he passed the test while intoxicated, he is also known as "The Lucky Drunk," "The Drunken Hero," or "The Accidental God."
pathfinder_origins.Crude and boorish, foulspawn take a part: Crude and boorish, foulspawn take a particular delight in giving offense and scandalizing polite society. They enjoy violating taboos even more than breaking laws, especially if it means degrading or repulsing an innocent.
pathfinder_origins.Dahak is the patron deity of evil dragon: Dahak is the patron deity of evil dragons, particularly the chromatic dragons. He is a god of destruction, chaos, rage, and draconic greed — the polar opposite of his father, Apsu the Waybringer, with whom he wages an endless war.
pathfinder_origins.Desna, also known as \"The Great Dreamer: Desna, also known as "The Great Dreamer," "Lady Luck," and "Mother Moon," the goddess of dreams, luck, stars, and travelers, is among the most ancient of deities. While her peers burdened themselves with the task of creating Golarion, she spent her time building the heavens. She knew that there would be plenty of time for her and her followers to explore the many wonders of the world later. She's changed little since those earlier days, and she and her followers delight in exploring the world.
pathfinder_origins.Dhampirs descended from the Vampire King: Dhampirs descended from the Vampire King are rare in the extreme. Incredibly beautiful but strikingly grim shades that straddle the line between humanity and vampirekind, sacred ancestry dhampirs are often single-minded loners intent on a specific goal.
pathfinder_origins.Dhampirs who can trace their heritage to: Dhampirs who can trace their heritage to moroi are known as svetochers, and they inherit much of the unnatural charm and beauty exhibited by their vampiric forebears. Svetochers tend to have an easier time than other dhampirs when associating with mortals, though they must be careful That their relatively wanton social interactions do not breed jealousy, resentment, or disdain. They are more often hunted out of covetousness or spite than outright prejudice, so they typically develop social skills that allow them to soothe wounds caused by accidental slights or careless acts.
pathfinder_origins.Dreads are humans whose ancestry include: Dreads are humans whose ancestry includes the touch of an elemental being of earth somewhere along the line, often that of a shaitan genie. Stoic and contemplative, oreads are a race not easily moved, yet almost unstoppable when spurred to action. They remain a mystery to most of the world thanks to their reclusive nature, but those who seek them out in their secluded mountain hideaways find oreads to be quiet, dependable, and protective of their friends.
pathfinder_origins.Dreary and pessimistic, grimspawn are so: Dreary and pessimistic, grimspawn are so enthralled by death, disease, and dilapidation that they often dedicate themselves to ending lives from behind the scenes as macabre saboteurs.
pathfinder_origins.Dwarves are a short and stocky race, and: Dwarves are a short and stocky race, and stand about a foot shorter than most humans, with wide, compact bodies that account for their burly appearance.
pathfinder_origins.Dwarves are a stoic but stern race, ensc: Dwarves are a stoic but stern race, ensconced in cities carved from the hearts of mountains and fiercely determined to repel the depredations of savage races like ogres and goblins. More than any other race, the dwarves have acquired a reputation as dour and humorless craftsmen of the earth. It could be said that dwarven history shapes the dark disposition of many dwarves, for they reside in high mountains and dangerous realms below the earth, constantly at war with giants, goblins, and other such horrors.
pathfinder_origins.Elves have long drawn the covetous gazes:
Elves have long drawn the covetous gazes of other races. Their generous life spans, magical affinity, and inherent grace each contribute to the admiration or bitter envy of their neighbors. Of all their traits, however, none so entrance their human associates as their beauty. Since the two races first came into contact with each other, the humans have held up elves as models of physical perfection, seeing in the fair folk idealized versions of themselves.

For their part, many elves find humans attractive despite their comparatively barbaric ways, drawn to the passion and impetuosity with which members of the younger race play out their brief lives. Sometimes this mutual infatuation leads to romantic relationships.

Though usually short-lived, even by human standards, these trysts commonly lead to the birth of half-elves, a race descended of two cultures yet inheritor of neither. Half-elves can breed with one another, but even these "pureblood" half-elves tend to be viewed as bastards by humans and elves alike.
pathfinder_origins.Endowed with brawny muscles and thick bo: Endowed with brawny muscles and thick bones, hungerseed always seem poised to explode into some larger, more powerful form, and have a voracious appetite for sensory pleasures and carnal delights.
pathfinder_origins.Erastil, also known as \"Old Deadeye\" a: Erastil, also known as "Old Deadeye" and "The Stag God," is one of the oldest human gods still worshiped in the Inner Sea region, and is concerned with family, farming, hunting, and trade. During the Age of Creation, Erastil was among the gods who battled Rovagug when he sought to destroy Golarion. They were eventually able to contain him in the Dead Vault at the planet's core. His religion dates back to before the Age of Darkness, when small farming communities and hunter-gatherers prayed to him for bountiful harvests and successful hunts. Legends claim that it was Old Deadeye himself who crafted the first bow and gifted it to humans to overcome the challenges of the world. Even as the accomplishments of civilization mount, Erastil continues to embrace and represent the simpler pleasures life has to offer.
pathfinder_origins.Fighters are adept at physically damagin: Fighters are adept at physically damaging their enemies. They have access to a vast array of abilities which allow to turn them into either masters of melee fighting, or deadly sharpshooters. Fighters are also great at employing armor and shields, which allows them to become reliable protectors for their allies. However, they are unable to use magic, and their weak willpower make them vulnerable to hostile magic.
pathfinder_origins.Gnomes trace their lineage back to the m: Gnomes trace their lineage back to the mysterious realm of the fey, a place where colors are brighter, the wildlands wilder, and emotions more primal. Unknown forces drove the ancient gnomes from that realm long ago, forcing them to seek refuge in this world; despite this, the gnomes have never completely abandoned their fey roots or adapted to mortal culture. As a result, gnomes are widely regarded by the other races as alien and strange.
pathfinder_origins.Gorum, also known as \"Our Lord in Iron,: Gorum, also known as "Our Lord in Iron," is a god of battle above all other pursuits; it is said that he would rust away into nothingness if there was ever a time with no more conflicts to be fought. His faithful believe he is present in every iron weapon of war that is forged.
pathfinder_origins.Gozreh is a dualistic deity of nature, a: Gozreh is a dualistic deity of nature, a god of the storm and sky and also a goddess of the wave and surf. Born of the ocean's fury and the wind's wrath, Gozreh is a fickle deity.
Half-orcs get the worst of both worlds. Still, while not exactly accepted, half-orcs in civilized societies tend to be valued for their martial prowess. They are usually forced to grow up hard and fast, constantly fighting for protection or to make names for themselves. Feared, distrusted, and spat upon, half-orcs still consistently manage to surprise their detractors with great deeds and unexpected wisdom - though sometimes it's easier just to crack a few skulls.
pathfinder_origins.Humans possess exceptional drive and a g:
Humans possess exceptional drive and a great capacity to endure and expand, and as such are currently the dominant race in the world. Their empires and nations are vast, sprawling things, and the citizens of these societies carve names for themselves with the strength of their sword arms and the power of their spells.

Humanity is best characterized by its tumultuousness and diversity, and human cultures run the gamut from savage but honorable tribes to decadent, devil-worshiping noble families in the most cosmopolitan cities. Human curiosity and ambition often triumph over their predilection for a sedentary lifestyle, and many leave their homes to explore the innumerable forgotten corners of the world or lead mighty armies to conquer their neighbors, simply because they can.
pathfinder_origins.Hunters are warriors of the wilds that h: Hunters are warriors of the wilds that have forged close bonds with trusted animal companions. They focus their tactics on fighting alongside their companion animals as a formidable team of two. Able to cast a wide variety of nature spells and take on the abilities and attributes of beasts, hunters magically improve both themselves and their animal companions.
pathfinder_origins.Idyllkin possess bestial aspects and cal: Idyllkin possess bestial aspects and calm dispositions, and often act as peaceful intermediaries between lawful and chaotic agents of good.
pathfinder_origins.Imprisoned since the Age of Creation, th: Imprisoned since the Age of Creation, the god Rovagug, also known as "The Rough Beast", "The Great Destroyer" and "The Worldbreaker", seeks only to destroy creation and the other gods. Believed to be imprisoned in a state of torpor somewhere deep within Golarion, his increasingly restless stirrings are taken by many to be the cause of volcanic activity and earthquakes. His worshipers are known for embodying the god's dominion over destruction, disaster, and wrath.
pathfinder_origins.In addition to magical extracts, alchemi: In addition to magical extracts, alchemists are adept at swiftly mixing various volatile chemicals and infusing them with their magical reserves to create powerful bombs that they can hurl at their enemies.
pathfinder_origins.Inquisitors tend to move from place to p: Inquisitors tend to move from place to place, chasing down enemies and researching emerging threats. As a result, they often travel with others, if for no other reason than to mask their presence. Inquisitors work with members of their faith whenever possible, but even such allies are not above suspicion.
pathfinder_origins.Iomedae, also known as \"The Inheritor,\: Iomedae, also known as "The Inheritor," "Light of the Sword," and "Lady of Valor," is the goddess of righteous valor, justice, and honor. Having served as Aroden's herald, she inherited many of the Last Azlanti's followers upon his death, and continues to espouse the ideas of honor and righteousness in the defense of good and the battle against evil.
pathfinder_origins.Irori, also known as \"Master of Masters: Irori, also known as "Master of Masters", "The Enlightened One" and "The Perfect Human," is the god of enlightenment, self-perfection, knowledge, healing, and inner strength. His followers claim that he was once a mortal who achieved absolute physical and mental perfection and thus attained divinity of his own volition. He is one of the core gods, if not the most powerful deity, of the Vudrani pantheon, but has an increasing following in the Inner Sea region as well.
pathfinder_origins.Keen Kitsune are notoriously clever and: Keen Kitsune are notoriously clever and cunning, often far more than they seem.
pathfinder_origins.Kineticists channel raw elemental power: Kineticists channel raw elemental power and matter of the Ethereal Plane into their bodies, manifesting in strange effects known as kinesis. Their powers often confuse others into believing they are monks or sorcerers.
pathfinder_origins.Kineticists start with an elemental quar: Kineticists start with an elemental quarterstaff
pathfinder_origins.Kistune are agile and companionable, but: Kistune are agile and companionable, but tend to be physically weak.
pathfinder_origins.Kitsune, or fox folk, are vulpine shapes:
Kitsune, or fox folk, are vulpine shapeshifters known for their love of both trickery and art. Kitsune possess two forms: that of an attractive human of slender build with salient eyes, and their true form of an anthropomorphic fox.

Despite an irrepressible penchant for deception, kitsune prize loyalty and make true companions. They delight in the arts, particularly riddles and storytelling, and settle in ancestral clans, taking their wisdom from both the living and spirits.
pathfinder_origins.Known to her faithful as the \"Dawnflowe: Known to her faithful as the "Dawnflower", "The Healing Light", and "The Everlight", Sarenrae is a goddess who teaches temperance and patience in all things. Compassion and peace are her greatest virtues, and if enemies of the faith can be redeemed, they should be. Worship of this goddess of healing, honesty, redemption, and the sun began far to the east of the Inner Sea, in the vast Padishah Empire of Kelesh, but her worshipers can now be found throughout the world.
pathfinder_origins.Lacking any sense of empathy or pity, Fa: Lacking any sense of empathy or pity, Faultspawn often abhor all ways of life but their own. They inflict severe emotional and physical pain on others, and never stop picking at the resulting psychological scars.
pathfinder_origins.Lamashtu, also known as \"Mother of Mons: Lamashtu, also known as "Mother of Monsters", is the mother and patroness of many misshapen and malformed creatures that crawl, slither or flap on, above or below the surface of Golarion.
pathfinder_origins.Lawbringers are champions of justice and: Lawbringers are champions of justice and of doling out punishment to the wicked, and often believe chaos is the cause of all mortal suffering.
pathfinder_origins.Lead blades increases the momentum and d: Lead blades increases the momentum and density of your melee weapons just as they strike a foe.
pathfinder_origins.Life is an endless adventure for those w: Life is an endless adventure for those who live by their wits. Ever just one step ahead of danger, rogues bank on their cunning, skill, and charm to bend fate to their favor. Never knowing what to expect, they prepare for everything, becoming masters of a wide variety of skills, training themselves to be adept manipulators, agile acrobats, shadowy stalkers, or masters of any of dozens of other professions or talents. Thieves and gamblers, fast talkers and diplomats, bandits and bounty hunters, and explorers and investigators all might be considered rogues, as well as countless other professions that rely upon wits, prowess, or luck. Although many rogues favor cities and the innumerable opportunities of civilization, some embrace lives on the road, journeying far, meeting exotic people, and facing fantastic danger in pursuit of equally fantastic riches. In the end, any who desire to shape their fates and live life on their own terms might come to be called rogues.
pathfinder_origins.Magi spend much of their time traveling: Magi spend much of their time traveling the world, learning whatever martial or arcane secrets they can find. They might spend months learning a new sword-fighting style from a master warrior, while simultaneously moonlighting in the local library, poring through tomes of ancient lore. Most who take this path dabble in all sorts of lore, picking up anything that might aid them in their search for perfection.
pathfinder_origins.Masters of fire magic, emberkin feel the: Masters of fire magic, emberkin feel the dual pull of their peri forebear as well as that of a fallen angel further down their ancestry, and wrestle with their urges to do both good and evil.
pathfinder_origins.Members of this race are generally distr: Members of this race are generally distrusted by others. Villagers will increase their prices for you.

Members of this race are generally less intelligent than others, decreasing their spell power.
pathfinder_origins.Members of this race are generally more: Members of this race are generally more charismatic than others, increasing their mana regeneration.
Members of this race are generally more dextrous than others, increasing their attack speed
Members of this race are generally more fragile than others, reducing their maximum health.
Members of this race are generally more intelligent than others, increasing their spell power.
Members of this race are generally more sturdy than others, increasing their maximum health.

pathfinder_origins.Members of this race are generally weake: Members of this race are generally weaker than others, reducing their attack damage

pathfinder_origins.Members of this race are one of the smal: Members of this race are one of the smallest of the common races, generally standing just over 3 feet in height
pathfinder_origins.Members of this race are taller than hum: Members of this race are taller than humans
pathfinder_origins.Monks excel at overcoming even the most: Monks excel at overcoming even the most daunting perils, striking where it's least expected, and taking advantage of enemy vulnerabilities. Fleet of foot and skilled in combat, monks can navigate any battlefield with ease, aiding allies wherever they are needed most.
pathfinder_origins.More often the result of curiosity or ex: More often the result of curiosity or experimentation Than mating, the dhampir offspring of vetalas are born with sharp minds and are inclined to ask questions. Known as ajibachanas, they are forceful and precocious, but their progenitors' distaste for the devout is mirrored in their weakness around holy or unholy sites. Just like their vampire parents, ajibachanas yearn for knowledge and often engage in scholarly pursuits, but their mortality drives them to work harder and learn faster. In a few short decades, they might gain a better understanding of themselves and their accumulated knowledge than Their eternally childish parents ever could have.
pathfinder_origins.More than capable of upholding the honor: More than capable of upholding the honor of their deities in battle, clerics often prove stalwart and capable combatants. Their true strength lies in their capability to draw upon the power of their deities, whether to increase their own and their allies' prowess in battle, to vex their foes with divine magic, or to lend healing to companions in need. As their powers are influenced by their faith, all clerics must focus their worship upon a divine source.
pathfinder_origins.Most aasimars do not know exactly where: Most aasimars do not know exactly where their celestial powers came from, and the similar qualities of many such celestially touched beings hint at a relatively indistinct or all-encompassing heavenly force in their lineage.
pathfinder_origins.Nethys, also known as \"The All-Seeing E: Nethys, also known as "The All-Seeing Eye", is a Garundi god who holds knowledge and magic above all things. He gained enough power to witness all things, and this both fueled his divinity and shattered his mind. He is a god of magic, torn between destroying the world with one hand and saving it with the other.
pathfinder_origins.No woman survives the birth of a babe wh: No woman survives the birth of a babe whose qlippoth ancestry has emerged. At best, qlippoth-spawn rip their mothers apart during labor. At worst, they tear themselves out even earlier.
pathfinder_origins.Norgorber is known as the once-mortal go: Norgorber is known as the once-mortal god of thievery and assassination, as well as a keeper of secrets. He is called the "Reaper of the Reputation" by some, but he has more insidious titles among worshipers who venerate his other three aspects: "Blackfingers", "Father Skinsaw", and the "Gray Master". He remains an enigma to most, and his true motives are unknown. Many of his own followers remain ignorant of his plans and designs. Norgorber is the only evil god amongst the Ascended.
pathfinder_origins.Optimistic and cheerful by nature, bless:
Optimistic and cheerful by nature, blessed with uncanny luck and driven by a powerful wanderlust, halflings make up for their short stature with an abundance of bravado and curiosity. At once excitable and easy-going, halflings like to keep an even temper and a steady eye on opportunity, and are not as prone as some of the more volatile races to violent or emotional outbursts. Even in the jaws of catastrophe, a halfling almost never loses his sense of humor.

Halflings are inveterate opportunists. Unable to physically defend themselves from the rigors of the world, they know when to bend with the wind and when to hide away. Yet a halfling's curiosity often overwhelms his good sense, leading to poor decisions and narrow escapes.

Though their curiosity drives them to travel and seek new places and experiences, halflings possess a strong sense of house and home, often spending above their means to enhance the comforts of home life.
pathfinder_origins.Oracles are perhaps the most mysterious: Oracles are perhaps the most mysterious divine casters. They are given power by a deity, often without their consent, that even they do not fully understand. Unlike clerics, who draw their power from a single divine source, oracles gain their strength from all the gods who share a compatible philosophy. While many see the powers of an oracle as a great blessing, others believe it to be a curse that radically alters the chosen one's life forever.
pathfinder_origins.Oreads are humans whose ancestry include: Oreads are humans whose ancestry includes the touch of an elemental being of earth somewhere along the line, often that of a shaitan genie. Stoic and contemplative, oreads are a race not easily moved, yet almost unstoppable when spurred to action. They remain a mystery to most of the world thanks to their reclusive nature, but those who seek them out in their secluded mountain hideaways find oreads to be quiet, dependable, and protective of their friends.
pathfinder_origins.Paladins serve as beacons for their alli: Paladins serve as beacons for their allies within the chaos of battle. While deadly opponents of evil, they can also empower goodly souls to aid in their crusades. Their magic and martial skills also make them well suited to defending others and blessing the fallen with the strength to continue fighting.
pathfinder_origins.Pitborn delight in destruction, especial: Pitborn delight in destruction, especially while unleashing their havoc on what others consider valuable or precious. Perhaps because of this volatility, others tend to simply defer to pitborn, an act that often grants them the dominance they crave.
pathfinder_origins.Rangers are deft skirmishers, either in: Rangers are deft skirmishers, either in melee or at range, capable of skillfully dancing in and out of battle. Their abilities allow them to deal significant harm to specific types of foes, but their skills are valuable against all manner of enemies.
pathfinder_origins.Rather than focus on the innate abilitie: Rather than focus on the innate abilities of their bloodlines or the research and study of the arcane magic, arcanists use their unique insight into the workings of magic to apply both approaches at once. Their distinct views on magic, extensive knowledge, and tremendous potential often leads them down reckless paths in pursuit of greater powers. Like a wizard, arcanists may call a familiar.
pathfinder_origins.Shackleborn are fascinated by mutilation: Shackleborn are fascinated by mutilation and torture. Though they prefer to practice their cruel art on others, they accept that sometimes the wheel must turn and greet their own moments of anguish and confinement with an odd serenity.
pathfinder_origins.Shamans deal in the spirits and energies: Shamans deal in the spirits and energies that surround and infuse the world around them, forming powerful bonds with them and invoking them for their powers, often in the form of a spirit animal.
pathfinder_origins.Shelyn, also known as \"The Eternal Rose: Shelyn, also known as "The Eternal Rose", "The Eternal Maiden" and "The Incorruptible", is the goddess of art, beauty, love, and music, and the half-sister of Zon-Kuthon. Shelyn focuses just as much attention on internal beauty as external. As aspects of her role as goddess of beauty, Shelyn also promotes the creation of art and the composing and performance of music. Clerics of Shelyn frequently are artists themselves. As the goddess of love, Shelyn encourages the proliferation of that feeling in all its forms. She is not the goddess of sexuality, lust, or fertility, and makes a very clear distinction between love and sexuality, although she does not in any way discourage erotic love. The few paladins who worship her practice courtly love.
pathfinder_origins.Shifters are sometimes called the wereto:
Shifters are sometimes called the weretouched, as many believe that they are the descendants of humans and lycanthropes. They are humanoids with a bestial aspect; while they cannot fully change shape they can temporarily enhance their animalistic features – a state they call shifting. Whatever their origins, shifters have evolved into a unique race. A shifter walks on the knife’s edge between the wilds and the world around them. Do they embrace their primal instincts or the path of civilization?

Shifters are protectors of druidic circles and avengers of nature, yet a shifter's magic is different from that of her druidic kin. Rather than invoking spells from the natural world or forging alliances with animals, shifters focus their supernatural powers inward to gain control over their own forms. Their ability to change their forms is as varied as the wonders of the wilds themselves but always remains at least partially rooted in the natural world. There are many paths to becoming a shifter; most are trained in that role by druidic circles and have their powers unlocked via rituals of initiation. Yet some stumble upon the gift naturally, as if their blood bore the secrets of shifter transformation.
pathfinder_origins.Simultaneously more and less than mortal:
Simultaneously more and less than mortal, tieflings are the offspring of humans and fiends. With otherworldly blood and traits to match, tieflings are often shunned and despised out of reactionary fear. Most tieflings never know their fiendish sire, as the coupling that produced their curse occurred generations earlier.

The taint is long-lasting and persistent, often manifesting at birth or sometimes later in life, as a powerful, though often unwanted, boon. Despite their fiendish appearance and netherworld origins, tieflings have a human’s capacity of choosing their fate, and while many embrace their dark heritage and side with fiendish powers, others reject their darker predilections.

Though the power of their blood calls nearly every tiefling to fury, destruction, and wrath, even the spawn of a succubus can become a saint and the grandchild of a pit fiend an unsuspecting hero.
pathfinder_origins.Skalds are poets, historians, and keeper: Skalds are poets, historians, and keepers of lore who use their gifts for oration and song to inspire allies into a frenzied rage. They balance a violent spirit with the veneer of civilization, recording events such as heroic battles and the deeds of great leaders, enhancing these stories in the retelling to earn bloodier victories in combat. A skald’s poetry is nuanced and often has multiple overlapping meanings, and he applies similar talents to emulate magic from other spellcasters.
pathfinder_origins.Slayers are shadowy assassins who specia: Slayers are shadowy assassins who specialize in stalking their mark, studying it, killing it, and escaping.
pathfinder_origins.Some gain power through study, some thro: Some gain power through study, some through devotion, others through blood, but the witch gains power from her communion with the unknown. Generally feared and misunderstood, the witch draws her magic from a pact made with an otherworldly power. Communing with that source and using her familiar as a conduit, the witch gains not only a host of spells, but also a number of strange abilities known as hexes. As a witch grows in power, she might learn about the source of her magic, but some remain blissfully unaware. Some are even fearful of what that source might be, or where its true purposes lie.
pathfinder_origins.Sorcerers excel at casting a selection o: Sorcerers excel at casting a selection of favored spells frequently, making them powerful battle mages. As they become familiar with a specific and ever-widening set of spells, sorcerers often discover new and versatile ways of making use of magics other spellcasters might overlook. Their bloodlines also grant them additional abilities, assuring that no two sorcerers are ever quite alike.
